name: Handstand
description: A straight, stacked balance on the hands. Wall work builds the line and endurance, then freestanding practice builds the balance.

steps.label: Wall walk
steps.cue: Walk up only as far as you can keep your body straight.

steps.label: Back to wall handstand
steps.cue: Push tall through your shoulders and squeeze your legs.

steps.label: Chest to wall handstand
steps.cue: Hands close to the wall, ribs tucked, toes light on the wall.

steps.label: Wall handstand, one leg off
steps.cue: Balance through your fingers as the leg leaves the wall.

steps.label: Handstand kick-up
steps.cue: Count a rep only when you balance for three seconds.

steps.label: Freestanding handstand
steps.cue: Fix small drifts with your fingers and heels of your hands.
